description: This file defines the DataLabel class, which models a data label of a series in a chart within the PdfSharp.Charting namespace. It includes properties for formatting, positioning, and type, as well as methods for cloning and deep copying the object.

classes.name: DataLabel
classes.description: Represents a data label associated with a chart series, providing properties for label formatting, position, and type, along with cloning capabilities.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DataLabel object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation, including cloning the Font object if it exists.
